instruction.text: Freya is packing her pencil, rubber and notepad for school. Altogether the pencil, rubber and notepad weigh 73g. How much does the notepad weigh?

atoms.b:
Weight of the pencil and rubber:3 9`g`+3 9`g`=12`g`
Weight of the notepad: 73`g`-12`g`=61`g`

instruction.text: Casper is weighing an egg, some butter and some milk for baking. Altogether the egg, butter and milk weigh 190g. How much does the milk weigh?

atoms.b:
Weight of the egg and butter:40 50`g`+40 50`g`=90`g`
Weight of the milk: 190`g`-90`g`=100`g`

instruction.text: Lucia is buying a sandwich, a book and a bracelet at the market. Altogether the sandwich, book and bracelet cost £32. How much does the bracelet cost?

atoms.b:
Cost of the sandwich and book:£2 12+£2 12=£14
Cost of the bracelet: £32-£14=£18

instruction.text: Elijah is weighing a pumpkin, a piglet and a cheese wheel for the fair. Altogether the pumpkin, piglet and cheese wheel weigh 43kg. How much does the cheese wheel weigh?

atoms.b:
Weight of the pumpkin and piglet:6 24`kg`+6 24`kg`=30`kg`
Weight of the cheese wheel: 43`kg`-30`kg`=13`kg`

instruction.text: Ramona is buying a gift, a bouquet of flowers and a cake for her mum. Altogether the gift, flowers and cake cost £47. How much does the cake cost?

atoms.b:
Cost of the gift and flowers:£17 5+£17 5=£22
Cost of the cake: £47-£22=£25

instruction.text: Niran is buying a hat, a coat and a pair of earmuffs for winter. Altogether the hat, coat and earmuffs cost £62. How much do the earmuffs cost?

atoms.b:
Cost of the hat and coat:£8 43+£8 43=£51
Cost of the earmuffs: £62-£51=£11

instruction.text: Iris puts her purse, pen and keys into her bag. Altogether the purse, pen and keys weigh 97g. How much do the keys weigh?

atoms.b:
Weight of the purse and pen:53 26`g`+53 26`g`=79`g`
Weight of the keys: 97`g`-79`g`=18`g`

instruction.text: Dohyun is packing his paint, paintbrush and sketchbook. Altogether the paint, paintbrush and sketchbook weigh 99g. How much does the sketchbook weigh?

atoms.b:
Weight of the paint and paintbrush:38 17`g`+38 17`g`=55`g`
Weight of the sketchbook: 99`g`-55`g`=44`g`
